341.33 grams of each of:-

 All ingredients are added to sesame oil and oil is prepared by oil paak method.

 An herbal oil preparation which is used for external application, helps to balance the all three doshas i.e. vata, pitta and kapha in body. Apart from these it is good for diseases related to neck, eyes, ears and throat. It is also used as massage oil.

fullContent:
Triphaladi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Sahasrayogam, Taila Yoga Prakarana 44 
 Introduction 
 Triphaladi Thailam (Oil) is a classical formulation available as an Ayurvedic herbal oil. It is useful treatment for controlling headache, hair fall, grey hair etc. It has good use as external application. 
 Ingredients 
 341.33 grams of each of:- 
 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Amla – Emblica officinalis 
 Giloy – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Ketaki – Pandanus tectorius 
 Asanaka – Pterocarpus marsupium 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Castor – Ricinus communis 
 Indravalli – Citrullus colocynthis 
 water for decoction – 12.288 liters, boiled and reduced to 3.072 liters 
 Juice extract / decoction of Eclipta alba 
 Amla juice extract – Emblica officinalis 
 Taila – Sesame oil / Coconut oil–1.536 liters. 
 Cow milk – 1.536 liters 
 
 Use about 8 grams of fine powder of each ingredient to form paste:- 
 
 Kushta – Saussurea lappa 
 Licorice – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Padmaka – Prunus puddum 
 Usheera – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Rakta Chandana – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Ela – Cardamom – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Cinnamon – Cinnamomum zeylanicum 
 Mamsi – Nardostachys jatamansi 
 Ashwagandha – Withania somnifera 
 Bala – Sida cordifolia 
 Amruta – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Sariva – Hemidesmus indicus 
 Amarakashta – Cedrus deodara 
 Clove – Syzigium aromaticum 
 Nata – Valeriana wallichi 
 Choraka – Angelica glauca 
 Shweta Kamala – White lotus 
 Rakta Kamala – Nelumbium speciosum 
 Kalhara – Woodfordia fruticosa 
 Padma – Nelumbo nicufera 
 Anjana – Berberis aristata 
 Neeli – Indigofera tinctorea 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients are added to sesame oil and oil is prepared by oil paak method. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 An herbal oil preparation which is used for external application, helps to balance the all three doshas i.e. vata, pitta and kapha in body. It is used for various hair related problems like hair fall, grey hair, baldness etc. Massage of this oil over head provides relief from severe headache, sinusitis, and rhinitis, also shows positive results in relieving mental stress and fatigue. Apart from these it is good for diseases related to neck, eyes, ears and throat. It is also used as massage oil. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 It is very useful treatment in controlling split hair, grey hair and provides strength to hair. 
 It is effective in providing relief from headache, sinusitis and rhinitis. 
 Also good therapy in case of diseases related to neck, eyes, ear and throat. 
 
 How to Use? 
 It can be used as hair oil and for head massage. 
 Contraindications / Side Effects 
 No side effects are has been reported with external use of this oil. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
